description.narrative: The Ministry of Invalids and Social Affairs together with three target provinces (Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai and Hanoi) developed an initial version of an Electronic Case Management System (ECMS) to improve the efficiency and data collection of the labour inspection system in Viet Nam. The ECMS – to be piloted in the fourth quarter of 2021 – includes sector-based digital checklists to standardize field inspections, a sanctions module to help automate violation findings and measures, an indicators module to improve objective-based planning and performance monitoring, as well as a reports module to facilitate Viet Nam's reporting on the application of ILO Convention No. 81. This work also included improved inter-Ministerial collaboration between the Ministry Inspectorate, the Department of Work Safety and the Information Technology Department as a foundation for the shared ownership and viability of the system. With support from USDOL, the ILO contributed extensive technical support to the development of the ECMS. It procured and funded a local vendor to build the system while also providing direct technical inputs to the content design and functionality through frequent meetings.
